hni_tx_ok_ieee.description: IEEE frames transmitted with a good FCS.

hni_tx_ok_opt.description: OPT frames transmitted with a good FCS.

hni_rx_ok_ieee.description: IEEE frames received with a good FCS, no EOPB, and no MBE

hni_rx_ok_opt.description: OPT frames received with a good FCS, no EOPB, and no MBE

hni_tx_ok_65_to_127.description: Frames transmitted with a length of between 65 and 127 bytes and a good FCS.

hni_tx_ok_128_to_255.description: Frames transmitted with a length of between 128 and 255 bytes and a good FCS.

hni_tx_ok_256_to_511.description: Frames transmitted with a length of between 256 and 511 bytes and a good FCS.

hni_tx_ok_2048_to_4095.description: Frames transmitted with a length of between 2048 and 4095 bytes and a good FCS.

cq_dma_cmd_counts_1.description: Counts for each of the successfully parsed commands in C_DMA_OP_T . Offset into the counter array is equal to the OpCode. Incremented as the first flit of command is sent to OXE. These counters include commands issued using the DMA path, but not those issuing using the IDC path (see Errata 3194 ).

cq_cq_cmd_counts_1.description: Counts for each of the successfully parsed commands in C_CQ_OP_T and C_TGT_OP_T . Offset into the counter array is equal to the OpCode. Incremented as the first flit of command is processed by CQ (for CQ commands) or sent to LPE (target commands). Note that the OpCodes used by CQ commands and target commands do not overlap. CQ uses 0-2 and target uses 8-12.

cq_cq_oxe_num_stalls.description: Number of cycles on which a command flit is available for OXE but can not be sent because the flow queues are full.

cq_cq_tou_num_stalls.description: Number of cycles on which a command flit is available for TOU but can not be sent because the Prefetch unit does not have credits to send commands to the TOU command queue (in_ct_fifo_cq).

oxe_stall_idc_cmd_no_deq.description: Num cycles IDC command cannot be dequeued after obtaining cell (buffer).This is an OR of all MCUs with an IDC command that have been allocated a cell (buffer) but have not been granted by the command dequeue arbiter (to pop the flow queue in CQ).

oxe_stall_hdr_arb.description: Cycles waiting for header arb. This is counted in the HEADER state and is the OR of all MCUs that are contending to write their header into the Packet Buffer.

pct_req_ordered.description: Count of the number of ordered Portals request packets sent to HNI from OXE. This only includes Portals request packets that have responses. This does not include retry packets that are resent out of the SRB. This also does not include management packets generated by PCT.

pct_req_unordered.description: Count of the number of unordered Portals request packets sent to HNI from OXE. This only includes Portals request packets that have responses.

cq_num_idc_cmds_0.description: Number of successfully parsed immediate data commands. Pooled counter, pool determined by MEM_Q_STAT_CNT_POOL in the transmit queue descriptor base table ( Section 13.8.38 on page 636 ). Incremented as the first flit of an IDC command is sent to OXE

cq_num_idc_cmds_1.description: Number of successfully parsed immediate data commands. Pooled counter, pool determined by MEM_Q_STAT_CNT_POOL in the transmit queue descriptor base table ( Section 13.8.38 on page 636 ). Incremented as the first flit of an IDC command is sent to OXE

cq_num_idc_cmds_2.description: Number of successfully parsed immediate data commands. Pooled counter, pool determined by MEM_Q_STAT_CNT_POOL in the transmit queue descriptor base table ( Section 13.8.38 on page 636 ). Incremented as the first flit of an IDC command is sent to OXE

cq_num_idc_cmds_3.description: Number of successfully parsed immediate data commands. Pooled counter, pool determined by MEM_Q_STAT_CNT_POOL in the transmit queue descriptor base table ( Section 13.8.38 on page 636 ). Incremented as the first flit of an IDC command is sent to OXE

scope: Extra counters alongside existing TX/RX octets. Available and source-described; no operation-window deltas yet. Stall cycles are not GPU time; categories overlap.
